Term1: Antimicrobials for patients undergoing dental or oral mucosa to prevent bacterial endocarditis
Text:
# DRUGS FOR PATIENTS UNDERGOING DENTAL, ORAL, RESPIRATORY TRACT, OR ESOPHAGEAL PROCEDURES TO PREVENT BACTERIAL ENDOCARDITIS
## Preferred
## Inpatient

Amoxicillin 2 gm PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [R]
< OR >
Ampicillin 2 gm IV over 20 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]
## Primary Alternative
[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
< OR >
## Secondary Alternative, after assessment of beta-lactam reaction above
Azithromycin 500mg PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [M]
Patients unable to take oral medications
Cefazolin 1 gm IV over 20 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R] < OR >
Clindamycin 600 mg IV over 30 minutes, beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [H,O]
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Outpatient

## Primary Alternative
[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
## Secondary Alternative, after assessment of beta-lactam reaction above
Azithromycin 500mg PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [M]
